senses.gloss: (v. רָעַם Hithpa., and תַּרְעוֹמֶת) to make discontented, rebellious.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 43">Pesik. R. s. 43</cite>, end (ref. to <he>הרעמה</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 1:6">I Sam. I, 6</cite>) <he>את מְתַרְעֶמֶת אותה עלי וכ׳</he> thou attemptest to make her rebellious against me, v. <cite ref="T00908"><he>רָעַם</he></cite>.
